EdgeTtsSecurityToken.java contains a Java port of the Sec-MS-GEC v2
algorithm from edge-tts src/edge_tts/drm.py.

Upstream project: https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts
Author: rany (ranygh@riseup.net), as identified in upstream setup.cfg.
Sec-MS-GEC v2 contribution: HarryXiaoCN, upstream pull request #492.
Reference revision: 360fa8e1de354e1dda74c09bd695887d6a44df74
Reference source:
https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts/blob/360fa8e1de354e1dda74c09bd695887d6a44df74/src/edge_tts/drm.py

The upstream drm.py does not specify a separate copyright notice.
The upstream LICENSE is reproduced verbatim in edge-tts-LICENSE.txt;
it states that all files other than srt_composer.py are licensed under
GNU Lesser General Public License version 3. Copyright notices in that
file are preserved verbatim and apply as described there.

Changes: translated the Python algorithm into Java using int overflow
for modulo 2^32 arithmetic and Instant for five-minute FILETIME buckets.
This derived utility is licensed under LGPLv3 as the upstream source.
